loc.village_square.name: Village Square
loc.village_square.description: A sunlit cobbled square at the heart of the village. A stone fountain bubbles in the centre and villagers gather around market stalls and notice boards.

loc.bakery.name: Village Bakery
loc.bakery.description: A small bakery warm with the smell of yeast and baking. Shelves show loaves and pastries; a flour-dusted baker works behind the counter.

loc.market.name: Market
loc.market.description: A busy open market full of colourful stalls. Merchants sell produce, trinkets and herbs; the air is loud with haggling and laughter.

loc.inn.name: The Sleeping Dragon Inn
loc.inn.description: The Sleeping Dragon Inn is a cosy two-storey building with a low-ceiling common room, wooden tables and a crackling hearth where travellers rest.

loc.gate.name: South Gate
loc.gate.description: A stout stone gate that guards the southern road. The guard post overlooks the path into the nearby woods and the countryside beyond.

loc.forest_entrance.name: Forest Entrance
loc.forest_entrance.description: Where the village meets the trees: a narrow clearing with a worn trail heading into the forest. Birds call from the branches above.

loc.forest_path.name: Forest Path
loc.forest_path.description: A dirt track winding beneath tall pines. The path is strewn with roots and leaves; it feels quieter here, and the village recedes behind you.

loc.deep_forest.name: Deep Forest
loc.deep_forest.description: Deep in the forest the trees close in and light grows dim. Mossy stones and broken branches hint at long-forgotten ruins — danger lurks here.

item.ancient_relic.name: Ancient Relic
item.ancient_relic.lore: A heavy relic etched with weathered runes. It hums faintly when held near the old stones.

item.amulet.name: Silver Amulet
item.amulet.lore: A simple silver amulet engraved with a tiny tree — a common keepsake in the village.

item.torn_letter.name: Torn Letter
item.torn_letter.lore: A fragment of a letter, the edges singed. A hastily scrawled name is still legible.

npc.baker.name: Baker
npc.baker.dialogue: Welcome! Fresh bread straight from the oven.

npc.merchant.name: Merchant
npc.merchant.dialogue: Looking to trade? I have trinkets from distant towns and curios for the brave.

npc.innkeeper.name: Innkeeper
npc.innkeeper.dialogue: Welcome, weary traveller. Rooms, stew and stout — best in the county.

npc.bard.name: Bard
npc.bard.dialogue: A song for a coin! I know tales of the old road and the ruins beyond; listen close and I might tell you.

npc.goblin_chief.name: Goblin Chief
npc.goblin_chief.dialogue: You dare enter my forest? I will crush you! Bring me your bones and I will grow stronger.

quest.fetch_herbs.description: The Baker asks you to bring a bundle of Healing Herbs from the market so she can bake a special remedy for an ill child.

quest.defeat_goblin_chief.description: The village fears the Goblin Chief, whose raids have left tracks and stolen supplies. Defeat him and secure the Deep Forest.
